verified_facts.text: Amankila is on Bali's less-explored, truly rural east coast.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wend your way to Bali’s less-explored and truly rural east coast

verified_facts.text: Amankila is one of the original Aman resorts, and its name means "peaceful hill".
verified_facts.excerpt: One of the original Aman resorts, whose name means "peaceful hill,"

verified_facts.text: Architect Ed Tuttle's walkways zig-zag up the hillside, and the resort uses thatching and paras-stone walls.
verified_facts.excerpt: Architect Ed Tuttle’s walkways zig-zag up the hillside; thatching and paras-stone walls

verified_facts.text: The three-tier infinity pool was designed with inspiration from the nearby water palace at Ujung and sacred Mount Agung.
verified_facts.excerpt: The design of the three-tier infinity pool was inspired by the nearby water palace at Ujung and sacred Mount Agung.

verified_facts.text: The accommodation is standalone, alang-alang-roofed villa suites staggered on a hillside.
verified_facts.excerpt: Staggered on a hillside frothing with frangipani and bougainvillea are 34 standalone alang-alang-roofed villa suites.

verified_facts.text: The Beach Club occupies a stretch of private black volcanic sand.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Beach Club occupies a vast stretch of private, powder-soft black volcanic sand.

verified_facts.text: There is no spa, but Balinese massage and wellness sessions, including yoga, can be booked.
verified_facts.excerpt: There’s no spa, but you can book an excellent Balinese massage or an inspired wellness session, including yoga.

verified_facts.text: There is an outdoor gym and a lap pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: There’s an outdoor gym and an impressive lap pool.

verified_facts.text: The accommodation listing includes round-trip transfers from Bali International Airport (DPS).
verified_facts.excerpt: Round-trip transfers from Bali International Airport (DPS)

verified_facts.text: Use of non-motorised watersports equipment at the Beach Club is included.
verified_facts.excerpt: Use of non-motorised watersports equipment at the Beach Club

verified_facts.text: The Beach Dinner offers two candlelit tables on the sand, each with its own chef grilling over open flame.
verified_facts.excerpt: Two candlelit tables set apart on the sand, each with its own chef grilling dishes over open flame.

verified_facts.text: The Megibung Dinner is an East Balinese sharing tradition centred on Nasi Tumpeng, a cone-shaped rice offering symbolising Mount Agung.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gather for our Megibung Dinner and immerse in the cherished East Balinese tradition of sharing a vibrant platter centred on _Nasi Tumpeng_ \- a cone-shaped offering of rice symbolising Mount Agung

verified_facts.text: Traditional Afternoon Tea is served every afternoon at The Bar, with treats handmade by mothers from a nearby village.
verified_facts.excerpt: handmade treats crafted by mothers from a nearby village

verified_facts.text: Batu Jati Sunset is a cocktail and canape experience on the Batu Jati Rock Platform overlooking the Lombok Strait and the black sand beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Toast the sunset from our Batu Jati Rock Platform overlooking the Lombok Strait and Amankila’s black sand beach.

verified_facts.text: A hands-on Indonesian cooking class is led by the Balinese sous chef, using herbs and vegetables picked from the resort garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Learn the secrets of Indonesian cuisine in this hands-on cooking class with Amankila’s Balinese sous chef. After picking your own fresh herbs and vegetables from our garden

verified_facts.text: Sandikala is the signature dining venue, on the hillside with views of the Lombok Strait.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched on the hillside, Sandikala, Amankila's signature dining venue, offers mesmerising views of the Lombok Strait.

The open-air restaurant serves just-caught seafood, suckling pig, satay skewers and sambals.
